question: In a family of six people (A, B, C, D, E, F), there are two married couples. The lawyer is the father of A. B is a teacher and the mother of C. F is the grandfather of E and is a doctor. D is the grandmother of C and is a housewife. There is one lawyer, one teacher, one doctor, one housewife, and two students in the family. What is the profession of A?
